meta.name: research
meta.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调研问题并整理成 Markdown 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速调研并记录结果
copy.tagline_en: Research a question and save findings as Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly research and record findings

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会启动一个后台代理，帮你查找官方文档、源代码等一手资料，并将结果整理成 Markdown 文件保存到仓库中。
howto.when: 当你需要研究某个话题、收集文档或 API 信息，或者希望把阅读工作交给后台代理时触发。

say.text: 帮我研究一下 Python 的 asyncio 库的官方用法。
say.note: Claude 会启动后台代理查找官方文档并生成笔记。

say.text: 查一下 OpenAI API 的最新版本和变更日志。
say.note: 后台代理会搜索一手来源并保存结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will spin up a background agent to investigate your question using primary sources like official docs and source code, then save the findings as a Markdown file in the repo.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.

say_en.text: Research the official usage of Python's asyncio library.
say_en.note: Claude will launch a background agent to find official docs and create notes.

say_en.text: Look up the latest version and changelog of the OpenAI API.
say_en.note: The agent will search primary sources and save the results.
